# Verwaltung

> The firm's administration console in the Platform, where an administrator manages people and their roles, access groups, folder rules and document rights, and a second person confirms guarded actions.

## Identity

| Field | Value |

| Id | `L2-PLATFORM-ADMIN` |
| Kind | code |
| Owner | `ROLE-ENGINE-OWNER` |
| Level | 2 |
| Parent | `L1-WORKSPACE` |

## Purpose

### Responsible for

| Id | Statement | Code |
|---|---|---|
| `L2-PLATFORM-ADMIN/R-1` | People (A-01, A-02): create, deactivate and activate an account, reset a password, sign a person out everywhere, and set a person's roles and access groups. | `KnovasPlatform/components/docbridge_integration/src/web_interface/admin.py`; `KnovasPlatform/components/docbridge_integration/src/web_interface/templates/admin_people.html`; `KnovasPlatform/components/docbridge_integration/src/web_interface/static/js/admin_people.js` |
| `L2-PLATFORM-ADMIN/R-2` | Access (A-03, A-04): the access groups as a tree, the folder rules and a document's access groups, written through the Brain's access routes; a document's fields drawer. | `KnovasPlatform/components/docbridge_integration/src/web_interface/admin_documents.py`; `KnovasPlatform/components/docbridge_integration/src/web_interface/templates/admin_access_groups.html`; `KnovasPlatform/components/docbridge_integration/src/web_interface/templates/admin_documents.html`; `KnovasPlatform/components/docbridge_integration/src/web_interface/static/js/admin_documents.js` |
| `L2-PLATFORM-ADMIN/R-3` | Approvals: a guarded action (a document's access groups, a folder rule, erasing the corpus) is queued for a second person, who confirms or rejects it; an administrator acting alone is recorded as a bypass, and only an administrator switches the bypass. | `KnovasPlatform/components/docbridge_integration/src/web_interface/admin_approvals.py`; `KnovasPlatform/components/docbridge_integration/src/web_interface/guarded.py`; `KnovasPlatform/components/docbridge_integration/src/web_interface/templates/admin_approvals.html` |
| `L2-PLATFORM-ADMIN/R-4` | The console's one blueprint and its role gates, on which the other console pages (Ingestion, Dokumentfelder, System's checks) are mounted, and the console's stylesheet. The console draws no menu of its own - its pages are the entries of the navigation's area Verwaltung, which the shell draws; each page names itself to the navigation. | `KnovasPlatform/components/docbridge_integration/src/web_interface/admin.py`; `KnovasPlatform/components/docbridge_integration/src/web_interface/static/css/admin.css` |

### Not responsible for

- Accounts, roles, sessions, the audit log and the approval queue's storage; the Platform's identity package (src/identity) keeps them.
- Whether a person may read a document; the Brain decides, per customer, where enforcement is on.
- The console's Ingestion and Dokumentfelder pages and System's checks (admin_ingestion.py, admin_doc_fields.py, admin_system.py); they are mounted on this blueprint and have no card yet.
- «Was sieht …?» and the enforcement posture; today they are the Builder's (access window), and PMVP-41 and PMVP-42 bring them here.

### Terms

- guarded action (an action a second person must confirm: a document's access groups, a folder rule, erasing the corpus, an ingestion profile)
- bypass (an administrator acting alone on a guarded action, recorded as approval.bypassed)

## To review

| At | Why |
|---|---|
| `/owner` | Proposed owner, as for every card in this repository; one role per component is confirmed by a person (Software Map K4). |
| `/status` | Live or planned is not read from the code; the console is on main and runs where the Platform runs. |
| `/responsible_for` | PMVP-11 removed the row of tabs (templates/\_admin_tabs.html): one navigation. Who sees which entry is no longer a condition in a console template; the web app reads it from the gates this blueprint puts on its routes (app.py, \_admin_pages; the shell's card): each gate (\_require_roles) puts the set of roles it checks on the view it returns, as allowed_roles, and the web app reads that attribute. No gate's check changed. admin.css still holds the rules of the removed tabs (.admin .tabs) and rules that restyle the old navigation on the console's pages (.admin-page .app-sidebar and below); the shell's shell.css outranks the second group, and neither was removed, because admin.css was not among PMVP-11's files. |
| `/source_paths` | The work order's scope: the people, groups and access pages PMVP-40 to PMVP-42 change. guarded.py is here because only console modules use it (admin_documents.py, admin_ingestion.py). admin.css is the stylesheet of every console page, those without a card too. The other console modules (admin_ingestion.py, admin_doc_fields.py, admin_system.py) and their pages stay outside (boundaries.yaml, not_carded); their domain is open (DEC-0083 names the Admin pages, not each console module): the project that cards them decides. |
| `/operations` | The routes of admin_documents.py and admin_approvals.py are attached to the blueprint admin.py passes in, so the code reader shows them without the prefix /admin (e.g. GET /access-groups @web_interface.admin_documents.bp); the refs here name the served path. Backlog row B33 of the Software Map plan. |
| `/contract` | Plan § 7 names Verwaltung only in SHELL POST-01, whose server half ("the server refuses the page otherwise") is each route's N-1 here. Every other line of these routes (what they promise, their limits) has no source in § 7: PMVP-40 to PMVP-42 write them with their page tests (A-01 to A-06). The people tests call two of admin.py's ten routes (GET /admin/people, POST /admin/people/create); the other eight lines have no evidence and a review entry each (seen in the code, not covered by a test). |
